notes: ADAM POMEROY, 2022, Utah County Attorney, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20'. Born-digital typed fillable form, digitally signed ('Digitally signed by Adam Pomeroy / Reason: I authorize this signature / Date: 2022-07-05 17:38:14'), printed and re-scanned; every figure is machine type. *** THE 2022 FORM, CHARACTERISED (first 2022 filing of this chunk) *** SIX pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 AND p3 both 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p4 AND p5 both 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p6 'Summary Page' LAST. (1) THE SCHEDULES RUN TO MULTIPLE SHEETS and the two printed footers therefore do DIFFERENT work: on the first sheet of each schedule the filer wrote 'see next page' in the sum-of-all-pages Total line and put the real page figure in 'Subtotal for this page'; the last sheet of each schedule carries both. Each sheet was reconciled on its own subtotal first, then the sheets were added to the printed grand total. (2) The grid is still a FULLY BOXED 15-row grid, but the PITCH IS TIGHTER than 2020/2021 (~4.22 vs ~4.35), so the row count was counted on each page rather than carried over. (3) SCHEDULE B HAS A REAL PURPOSE COLUMN and all 20 rows fill it, including two rows whose purpose is the single word '(refund)'. (4) The cover carries the same FIVE report types as the 2021 blank (including 'Seven days preceding Convention'); '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is filled and the amendment question is answered No. (5) FOLIATION IS COMPLETE AND COVER-COUNTED — the Page box reads 1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6 — which independently confirms the retained document is whole. (6) NO CHECKLIST IS BOUND INTO THIS FILING: all six pages are report pages and only p6 carries the summary labels, each with a figure. (7) TWO BLANK VINTAGES ARE MIXED WITHIN THE ONE FILING AGAIN: pp1, 4 and 5 carry the 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' masthead, pp2, 3 and 6 the older 'Amelia Powers Gardner' masthead — the addendum-F6 independent-stocking property. A NEW CAUSE OF A BLANK DONOR CITY/STATE, seen on 20 of the 22 contribution rows: the 'Address and Zip Code' cell contains the single word 'online' — a payment channel, not an address at all — so city and state are honestly blank for a reason distinct from the seven already catalogued (redacted by the county; left empty by the filer; a zip and no city; lost in reproduction; a city and zip but no state; the document has no address field; the cell holds something that is not an address, e.g. 'Paypal'). This is nearest the last of those but is worth its own note because it recurs on a whole schedule. Two further rows print only the word 'Utah', giving a state with no city. Columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen): every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or organisation, every purpose cell a purpose — no inversion, though ONE vendor cell names an event rather than a payee (p5 row 1, 'Meet&Greet PG Elementary') and is flagged rather than reinterpreted. THE COVER'S WHOLE Address / City / State / Zip ROW IS EMPTY — white space, no redaction bar — so it was left blank by the filer, not blacked out by the county; the phone number and email ARE published in the clear and were deliberately not carried. All six row-index traps screened on all four schedule sheets: first written entry is band 1 everywhere (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, nothing below the last printed rule (crop-proved on the two FULL sheets, p2 and p4, where the risk is real), and no doubled band — all four grids are uniform-pitch and every sheet closes to the cent on its own printed subtotal.
